issues.quote: The regulator on the wall had stopped. His little repeater was in his hand, the one he spent four years on, and his hand was closed on it.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about any stopped clock or about the repeater watch's state. All four readings (R1 to R4) are stated correctly and attached to the kitchen clock or the temple and hall clocks as the sheet specifies.
issues.misreading: A solver could read the stopped regulator and the repeater in the dead man's hand as a time-of-death or time-of-event indication, which is a whereabouts/timing hint the sheet does not provide. The witness is not reporting a reading here, so this is extra content rather than a misattributed reading.
